summary: E2E tested Customer Portal Phase D (token afe748c700fc481497a5720e5d80acde), Owner Job Detail Phase 2, Settings Customer Page card, and cron endpoint. Discovered ONE CRITICAL crash on owner Job Detail (TDZ ReferenceError blocking the entire page); FIXED it in-place (declaration order of `load` vs `recordDelivered` useCallback). After the fix everything works: edit dialog opens, 403 from Airtable is handled gracefully (dialog stays open, toast surfaces), History tab renders, Compliance tab renders (record-delivered button correctly hidden since this project has no linked paperwork_ack). Portal flows all green: arrival window '9:00 AM – 9:30 AM', paperwork ack (empty-name toast + green done state + amber banner clears), confirm-move (Yes flips to confirmed, No is an sms: href), prep checklist elevator/parking anchor scrolls. Cron 401/200 verified. Settings 4th template 'T-48h reminder' + arrival-window input persist (30→45→30).

ui_bugs.issue: TDZ ReferenceError: 'Cannot access load before initialization'. `recordDelivered` useCallback listed `load` in its deps array before `load` was declared. Blocked every owner job detail page. FIXED by moving `load` declaration above `recordDelivered`.

issues: Move date uses native HTML input[type=date] (browser default date picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker used elsewhere in the app. Inconsistent UX + native picker styling doesn't match dark theme.

action_items: Review my in-place fix to /app/frontend/src/pages/JobDetail.jsx (declaration order for `load`/`recordDelivered` useCallback). Consider adding a lint rule (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps + no-use-before-define) so this class of TDZ bug is caught at CI time.
Optional/design: replace native <input type="date"> in JobEditDialog Move date with the shadcn Calendar popover used elsewhere so it matches the dark theme and behaves consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: JobDetail.jsx had recordDelivered useCallback referring to `load` from its dependency array before `load` was declared with const — classic TDZ bug that crashed every owner job detail render. Fixed by reordering. Recommend enabling `no-use-before-define` for `variables` in ESLint.
JobEditDialog uses a native date input; the rest of the app uses shadcn Calendar. Non-blocking but inconsistent.

rca of the issue: JobDetail crash — useCallback for `recordDelivered` was defined at line 52 and included `load` in its dependency array, but `load` was declared with `const` at line 64. Because of temporal dead zone semantics on `const`, evaluating the deps array during the first render throws ReferenceError. Reproduction: log in as owner, navigate to /projects/recaqXqdU0Xt5VfWI — react-error-overlay pops. Mitigation applied: move `const load = useCallback(...)` (and its `useEffect(() => load())` companion) above `const recordDelivered = useCallback(...)`. Verified the same page now loads and Edit/History/Compliance tabs all work.
